category: Dynamic Island, AI, companion, apps and quality of life

tweaks.name: Turn the notch into Apple's hardware Dynamic Island
tweaks.description: Replace the physical notch area with the Dynamic Island cutout behaviour Apple ships on Pro models.
tweaks.unsupported_reason: This is physical display silicon, not software. iPhone14,3 (iPhone 13 Pro Max) has a sensor notch in the panel; no file, framework or entitlement changes it. AirCard does not claim to do this and the whole Dynamic Island category is built on honest substitutes instead — see island.pill and island.live_activity.

tweaks.name: Responsive AI pill overlay
tweaks.description: An in-app expanding pill that switches between compact, expanded and full states while the AI works.
tweaks.rollback: UI only; nothing on the device changes.
tweaks.unsupported_reason: iPhone14,3 (iPhone 13 Pro Max) has a sensor notch, not a Dynamic Island cutout. There is no display region to render a pill into. Any 'pill' would have to be drawn inside your own app's window, which is not the system Dynamic Island.

tweaks.name: Dynamic Island-style Live Activity (AI listening / thinking / speaking / downloading)
tweaks.description: A Live Activity that reports AI state, model download progress, timers and AirCard operations.
tweaks.rollback: End the activity; the system removes it.
tweaks.unsupported_reason: Live Activities render only into the hardware Dynamic Island cutout or the Lock Screen widget. With no cutout on this device there is no island surface. The Lock Screen / Banner part is available to an app via ActivityKit, but that requires a signed .ipa, which cannot be built on this machine (no macOS/Xcode).

tweaks.name: Music controls in the Dynamic Island surface
tweaks.description: Now Playing controls inside the app's pill surface.
tweaks.unsupported_reason: Now Playing in the Dynamic Island requires the hardware cutout. The MediaLibrary / MPNowPlayingInfoCenter route fills the Control Center and Lock Screen instead.

tweaks.name: Charging state in the Dynamic Island surface
tweaks.description: Show charging state and battery level in the in-app pill.
tweaks.unsupported_reason: The charging animation in the Dynamic Island is tied to the hardware cutout and the system charging UI, neither of which is reachable by writing files.

tweaks.name: Timer and countdown in the Dynamic Island surface
tweaks.description: A live countdown rendered in the pill surface.
tweaks.unsupported_reason: System timers render in the Dynamic Island cutout. A custom timer can only be drawn inside an app.

tweaks.name: Animated AI orb (idle / listening / thinking / speaking / vision / tool / error / offline)
tweaks.description: The state-driven orb that visualises what the assistant is doing.
tweaks.unsupported_reason: The orb is an animated SwiftUI/Metal view. It can only exist inside a signed iOS app. AirCard-iOS on Windows can write files to the device but cannot ship, sign or install an .ipa (no macOS/Xcode here), so there is nothing to render.

tweaks.name: Local on-device chat (no cloud required)
tweaks.description: Run a downloaded model on the Neural Engine / GPU and stream responses with no network.
tweaks.rollback: Unload the model; no device state persists.
tweaks.unsupported_reason: Requires an on-device LLM runtime (llama.cpp / MLX / CoreML) compiled into a signed iOS app. Nothing exists to run on the device yet, and no .ipa can be produced from this machine.

tweaks.name: Model library: download, pause, resume, verify, load, unload, delete
tweaks.description: A registry of local models with size, RAM requirement, context length and capability flags, managed on disk.
tweaks.rollback: Delete the model file; it lives in the app container.
tweaks.unsupported_reason: The registry/UI logic exists in the Windows GUI, but downloading and running a GGUF/MLX model needs an iOS-side inference runtime in a signed app. Cannot be built or verified here.

tweaks.name: Model memory manager (never load every model at once)
tweaks.description: Watch available memory, unload idle models and refuse to load a model that would not fit.
tweaks.unsupported_reason: Memory budgeting only matters once a runtime can load models. No iOS runtime exists, so this has no device effect.

tweaks.name: On-device vision: describe, OCR, answer questions about an image
tweaks.description: Feed a camera frame, photo or screenshot to a local vision model and answer questions about it.
tweaks.unsupported_reason: On-device vision needs CoreML/Vision inside a signed app with camera/photo entitlements. Not buildable or verifiable on this machine.

tweaks.name: On-device speech recognition and TTS
tweaks.description: Speech to text, text to speech, voice activity detection and barge-in, all running locally.
tweaks.unsupported_reason: Speech recognition (Speech framework) and TTS (AVSpeechSynthesizer) must run inside an app. No signed .ipa can be produced here, so nothing runs on the phone.

tweaks.name: Always-on wake word in the background
tweaks.description: Listen for a wake phrase continuously, hands-free, with the screen off and the app closed.
tweaks.unsupported_reason: iOS does not grant an app unrestricted background microphone access or a hotword privilege that survives the app being suspended. The legitimate mechanisms are the App Intents / SiriKit voice phrase, Shortcuts automation, a Live Activity prompt, or a push-to-talk control in a Live Activity. AirCard implements those and labels this entry unsupported rather than shipping a wake word that only works while the app happens to be foregrounded.

tweaks.name: Agent tool router with sequential tool calls
tweaks.description: Plan, call tools in sequence, check permissions, then summarise — with an action log and no chain-of-thought exposure.
tweaks.unsupported_reason: The tool router is app-side orchestration around a model runtime. Neither exists on the device.

tweaks.name: Privacy centre: mic / camera / photos / location / cloud / memory
tweaks.description: One place showing exactly what AirCard AI has been allowed to use and whether anything left the device.
tweaks.unsupported_reason: A permissions UI for the app's own entitlements. There is no installed AirCard app on this device to grant anything to.

tweaks.name: Anime companion with user-supplied art
tweaks.description: A companion character driven by the same local AI, animating idle / listening / thinking / speaking states with a local voice.
tweaks.rollback: UI only; imported art lives in the app container.
tweaks.unsupported_reason: Requires rendering an animated companion view in an app plus user-supplied art files. Copyrighted characters cannot be bundled; art must come from the user.

tweaks.name: Bundle copyrighted anime characters
tweaks.description: Ship well-known anime characters with the app out of the box.
tweaks.unsupported_reason: Bundling third-party characters without a licence is both illegal and a liability. The companion ships with original art only, and the user imports their own PNG/WEBP assets. Refusing this is a deliberate design decision, not a missing feature.

tweaks.name: AI search in Spotlight
tweaks.description: Add AirCard AI as a Spotlight search result that answers a query.
tweaks.unsupported_reason: Spotlight indexing extensions must be declared in an app's Info.plist and run in a signed app.

tweaks.name: AI music analysis and theme
tweaks.description: Analyse a track locally and build a theme from it, with Now Playing shown in the pill surface.
tweaks.unsupported_reason: Needs an audio pipeline + model inside an app to analyse what is playing.

tweaks.name: Read private messages without permission
tweaks.description: Let the assistant read the user's message history on its own.
tweaks.unsupported_reason: Messages stores its threads in a protected app container. iOS gives no third-party app read access to another app's database, and the only legitimate route is the user explicitly sharing a conversation into AirCard or granting Contacts access. Listed so the catalogue is complete and the line is explicit.

tweaks.name: Draft a message from the AI and hand it to the user
tweaks.description: Have the assistant draft text and pass it to the user to review and send.
tweaks.unsupported_reason: Writing a draft into Messages requires either a Messages extension (signed app) or UI automation; both need a signed .ipa. AirCard deliberately does not fabricate 'AI generated' output.

tweaks.name: Custom call screen appearance
tweaks.description: Restyle the incoming / active call interface.
tweaks.unsupported_reason: Call UI is drawn by the system Phone app and SpringBoard with no writable appearance store. AirCard can generate a wallpaper or contact artwork for the user to set, but cannot restyle the call screen itself.

tweaks.name: Contact and call artwork
tweaks.description: Generate artwork for a contact or a call screen background.
tweaks.unsupported_reason: Caller artwork is app-side rendering on top of the call UI; not writable as files.

tweaks.name: Send a photo to the AI from the camera roll
tweaks.description: Pick or capture a photo and run it through the local vision model.
tweaks.unsupported_reason: Handing a photo to a model needs an app with photo-library access and a runtime.

tweaks.name: Live camera AI ("what am I looking at?")
tweaks.description: Stream camera frames to a local vision model and answer spoken questions about what is in view.
tweaks.unsupported_reason: Live camera analysis requires a running app holding the camera; impossible from a file-write tool.

tweaks.name: Read other apps' screens without the user
tweaks.description: Capture and interpret the contents of whatever app is in the foreground.
tweaks.unsupported_reason: iOS only lets an app capture its own window. Reading another app's screen requires either a jailbreak or the user sharing a screenshot into AirCard. The honest path is the share sheet and the Photos picker, both of which are implemented.

tweaks.name: Run unlimited code in the background
tweaks.description: Keep inference, downloads and agents alive indefinitely in the background.
tweaks.unsupported_reason: iOS suspends and terminates background apps; long work is expected to use background tasks, ActivityKit and push. Legitimate mechanisms exist and AirCard uses them for downloads and Live Activities, but genuinely unbounded background execution is not granted to any app and is documented as such.

tweaks.name: Optional cloud AI providers (OpenAI / Anthropic / Google / OpenRouter / LAN)
tweaks.description: Opt-in cloud backends, off by default, with an always-visible LOCAL / CLOUD indicator.
tweaks.rollback: Keys are stored in the Keychain and can be removed at any time.
tweaks.unsupported_reason: Requires network calls with API keys from an app that stores them in the keychain. No signed app exists to hold keys, so this is deliberately not faked.

tweaks.name: Backup and restore of the whole AirCard setup
tweaks.description: Export themes, packs, tweaks and settings as a validated pack, and restore it.
tweaks.rollback: The pack file is the backup.
tweaks.unsupported_reason: The backup session does work: every real write is recorded with a manifest and a committed copy under backup/<udid>/<timestamp>/, and --restore replays it. It is marked as a local tool rather than a device tweak because the originals are often unreadable (AirLift has no read primitive).

tweaks.name: Full diagnostics report
tweaks.description: Check device, iOS build, permissions, AirLift state, storage, memory and every tweak's compatibility.
tweaks.unsupported_reason: The canary, probe_host and readback verification are implemented and run on every apply, but they are diagnostics rather than a device-visible feature.

tweaks.name: Developer mode: logs, latency, token counts, model info, tool calls
tweaks.description: An advanced panel with the engine's real measurements instead of invented benchmarks.
tweaks.unsupported_reason: Same as diagnostics: implemented in the Windows GUI, but it changes no file on the device.
